summary: fix(payments): new page resets in nextjs dev turbo
description:
Because:

- When running Next.js dev mode with turbo the new page resets before
  redirecting, resulting in the /new page constantly refreshing and not
  getting a redirect.
- Missing Sentry DSN causes an error log poluting logs.

This commit:

- Update Next.js to latest version to resolve /new page reset.
- Change missing Sentry DSN from log.error to log.info.

Closes #
